digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day closed with one confirmed milestone and a clearer implementation direction, while five actions remain open for follow-through. Tomorrow begins with a 10:30 AM conflict that needs coverage.

items.label: Amazon Connect UAT Phase 2 was completed
items.detail: Jean recognized Thiago and Nadia for completing the phase at about 80% coverage in record time, a significant step forward from Phase 1.

items.label: Close the Denver deployment and rollout follow-through
items.detail: Denver is scheduled to deploy Wednesday with a 48-hour monitoring window. Confirm the office milestones, remaining production testing, and the RingCentral transition communication for all affected Amazon Connect users.

items.label: Frame the RFE MHE decision due September 24
items.detail: The project is 42% complete and the September 30 target is no longer achievable. Put the four paths in decision-ready form with the Legal, IT, capacity, and task-set implications of any scope change.

items.label: Set the CM-CoE backlog and intake path
items.detail: The Phase 1 and 2 requests are prioritized but still need the next decision, owner, and follow-up date. Timetrack of Stage Completion also remains pending IT feedback.

items.label: Finalize the short-term Attorney Review rollout
items.detail: Confirm owners and training for the Service Cloud process, get Sara's guidance on the scope split, and schedule the Stage 2 assessment with IT.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Reply with the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the project waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: The RingCentral user-communication guidance meeting was canceled
items.detail: The time-sensitive meeting scheduled for late afternoon was explicitly canceled after the project team received approval to send the communication and was asked to coordinate the details with middle leadership.

items.label: Attorney Review will use Service Cloud for the short-term process
items.detail: The team moved away from a 48-hour turnaround toward real-time attorney review. New task sets, objects, and Litify changes were deferred to a later Stage 2 assessment with IT.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Attorney Review and Amazon Connect overlap
items.detail: Choose coverage for the priority Attorney Review session and the Denver deployment standup before the morning starts.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Thiago 1:1
items.detail: Use the conversation to close Amazon Connect rollout ownership and any remaining communication dependencies.

items.label: Noon-3:00 PM - Focus block, Sara 1:1, and EPMO team meeting
items.detail: Protect the noon work hour, then carry the day's decisions into the 1:30 PM Sara 1:1 and 2:00 PM team meeting.

items.label: 3:30-5:00 PM - Laura, weekly preparation, and Astrid
items.detail: Keep the sequence tight: Laura at 3:30 PM, weekly preparation at 4:00 PM, and Astrid at 4:30 PM.
